markdown: This is not a once in a lifetime clip, but.. I was just doing logistics runs when I found another Lakota (Blackhawk) at the FOB and I decided to fly in formation with them on the way back to our main base. Meanwhile I was listening music and the background started to changed to dusk and the golden glow of the mountains, combined with the emotional music, created a strong feeling of; fuck, I'm a badass operator! https://clip.place/w/oDwWHycXpn13ETfDagxKp7
